import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Arnold–Givental conjecture and Arnold conjecture

The *Arnold conjecture* bounds from below the number of fixed points of a Hamiltonian
diffeomorphism of a closed symplectic manifold $(M, ω)$ by Morse-theoretic invariants of $M$:
the minimal number of critical points of a smooth function on $M$ (strong form), the minimal number
of critical points of a Morse function on $M$ (nondegenerate form), or the sum of the Betti numbers
of $M$ (weak form).

The *Arnold–Givental conjecture* bounds from below the number of transverse intersection points
of a compact Lagrangian submanifold $L$, which is the fixed point set of an anti-symplectic
involution, with its image under a Hamiltonian diffeomorphism, by the sum of the $ℤ/2$-Betti
numbers of $L$.

This file introduces the required notions on top of Mathlib's smooth manifolds: symplectic forms
(fields of continuous alternating bilinear forms on the tangent spaces which are smooth and closed
in charts, and nondegenerate), time-dependent Hamiltonian flows, Hamiltonian diffeomorphisms,
nondegenerate diffeomorphisms, critical points, Morse functions, and Betti numbers via Mathlib's
singular homology. Time-dependent Hamiltonians are taken to be smooth functions on `ℝ × M`; the
time-one maps of their flows are exactly the time-one maps of smooth families indexed by `[0, 1]`
(reparametrise the time variable).

*References:*
- [Wikipedia, Arnold–Givental conjecture](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arnold%E2%80%93Givental_conjecture)
- [Wikipedia, List of unsolved problems in mathematics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_unsolved_problems_in_mathematics)
- [Fr04] Frauenfelder, U. *The Arnold–Givental conjecture and moment Floer homology*.
  International Mathematics Research Notices (2004).
  [arXiv:math/0309373](https://arxiv.org/abs/math/0309373)
- [RG17] Dimitroglou Rizell, G. and Golovko, R. *The number of Hamiltonian fixed points on
  symplectically aspherical manifolds*. [arXiv:1609.04776](https://arxiv.org/abs/1609.04776)
-/
namespace ArnoldGiventalConjecture
open scoped Manifold EuclideanGeometry
open Manifold Function
local notation "∞" => ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞)
section Definitions

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
  {H : Type*} [TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners ℝ E H)
  (M : Type*) [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M]

blocks.code: abbrev TwoForm := ∀ x : M, TangentSpace I x [⋀^Fin 2]→L[ℝ] ℝ
blocks.docstring:
A (not necessarily smooth) differential `2`-form on `M`: a continuous alternating bilinear
form on each tangent space `T_x M`.

justification.closest_existing_considered: Mathlib's `E → E [⋀^Fin n]→L[𝕜] F` forms on normed spaces (Analysis/Calculus/DifferentialForm), `Bundle.ContinuousLinearMap` Hom bundles (no alternating-form bundle exists).
justification.name: ArnoldGiventalConjecture.TwoForm
justification.why_needed: Mathlib has no differential forms on manifolds; a 2-form is encoded as a field of continuous alternating bilinear forms on the tangent spaces.

blocks.name: TwoForm
blocks.text:
/-- A (not necessarily smooth) differential `2`-form on `M`: a continuous alternating bilinear
form on each tangent space `T_x M`. -/
abbrev TwoForm := ∀ x : M, TangentSpace I x [⋀^Fin 2]→L[ℝ] ℝ
variable {I M}

blocks.code:
noncomputable def TwoForm.localRep (ω : TwoForm I M) (x₀ : M) (y : E) :
    E [⋀^Fin 2]→L[ℝ] ℝ :=
  (ω ((extChartAt I x₀).symm y)).compContinuousLinearMap
    (mfderivWithin 𝓘(ℝ, E) I (extChartAt I x₀).symm (Set.range I) y)
blocks.docstring:
The local representative of a `2`-form `ω` in the extended chart at `x₀`: the pullback of
`ω` along `(extChartAt I x₀).symm`, a `2`-form on the model space `E`.

justification.name: ArnoldGiventalConjecture.TwoForm.localRep
justification.why_needed: Local coordinate representative (pullback to the model space along `(extChartAt I x₀).symm`) used to express smoothness and closedness of a 2-form with Mathlib's normed-space calculus.

blocks.name: TwoForm.localRep
blocks.text:
/-- The local representative of a `2`-form `ω` in the extended chart at `x₀`: the pullback of
`ω` along `(extChartAt I x₀).symm`, a `2`-form on the model space `E`. -/
noncomputable def TwoForm.localRep (ω : TwoForm I M) (x₀ : M) (y : E) :
    E [⋀^Fin 2]→L[ℝ] ℝ :=
  (ω ((extChartAt I x₀).symm y)).compContinuousLinearMap
    (mfderivWithin 𝓘(ℝ, E) I (extChartAt I x₀).symm (Set.range I) y)

blocks.code:
structure IsSymplecticForm (ω : TwoForm I M) : Prop where
  contDiffWithinAt : ∀ x₀ : M,
    ContDiffWithinAt ℝ ∞ (ω.localRep x₀) (Set.range I) (extChartAt I x₀ x₀)
  closed : ∀ x₀ : M, extDerivWithin (ω.localRep x₀) (Set.range I) (extChartAt I x₀ x₀) = 0
  nondegenerate : ∀ (x : M) (v : TangentSpace I x), (∀ w, ω x ![v, w] = 0) → v = 0
blocks.docstring:
A `2`-form `ω` on `M` is a **symplectic form** if it is smooth, closed and nondegenerate.
Smoothness and closedness (`dω = 0`) are expressed through the local representatives of `ω` in
the extended charts at each point, using Mathlib's exterior derivative `extDerivWithin` on the
model space.

justification.name: ArnoldGiventalConjecture.IsSymplecticForm
justification.why_needed: No notion of symplectic form/manifold in Mathlib or FormalConjecturesForMathlib.

blocks.name: IsSymplecticForm
blocks.text:
/-- A `2`-form `ω` on `M` is a **symplectic form** if it is smooth, closed and nondegenerate.
Smoothness and closedness (`dω = 0`) are expressed through the local representatives of `ω` in
the extended charts at each point, using Mathlib's exterior derivative `extDerivWithin` on the
model space. -/
structure IsSymplecticForm (ω : TwoForm I M) : Prop where
  contDiffWithinAt : ∀ x₀ : M,
    ContDiffWithinAt ℝ ∞ (ω.localRep x₀) (Set.range I) (extChartAt I x₀ x₀)
  closed : ∀ x₀ : M, extDerivWithin (ω.localRep x₀) (Set.range I) (extChartAt I x₀ x₀) = 0
  nondegenerate : ∀ (x : M) (v : TangentSpace I x), (∀ w, ω x ![v, w] = 0) → v = 0

blocks.code:
def IsHamiltonianFlow (ω : TwoForm I M) (H : ℝ → M → ℝ) (φ : ℝ → M → M) : Prop :=
  ContMDiff (𝓘(ℝ, ℝ).prod I) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (uncurry H) ∧ φ 0 = id ∧
    ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : M), ∃ v : TangentSpace I (φ t x),
      HasMFDerivAt 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) I (fun s ↦ φ s x) t ((1 : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight v) ∧
        ∀ w : TangentSpace I (φ t x), ω (φ t x) ![v, w] = mfderiv I 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (H t) (φ t x) w
blocks.docstring:
`φ : ℝ → M → M` is the **Hamiltonian flow** of the time-dependent Hamiltonian
`H : ℝ → M → ℝ` with respect to the `2`-form `ω`: `H` is smooth (jointly in time and space),
`φ 0 = id`, and for every `x` the curve `t ↦ φ t x` solves `∂ₜ φ t x = X_{H t} (φ t x)`, where
the Hamiltonian vector field `X_{H t}` is characterised by `ω (X_{H t}, ·) = d (H t)`.

justification.name: ArnoldGiventalConjecture.IsHamiltonianFlow
justification.why_needed: Time-dependent Hamiltonian flows are not in Mathlib; defined by the ODE `∂ₜ φ = X_{H_t}` via `HasMFDerivAt` and the defining relation ω(X_H, ·) = dH.

blocks.name: IsHamiltonianFlow
blocks.text:
/-- `φ : ℝ → M → M` is the **Hamiltonian flow** of the time-dependent Hamiltonian
`H : ℝ → M → ℝ` with respect to the `2`-form `ω`: `H` is smooth (jointly in time and space),
`φ 0 = id`, and for every `x` the curve `t ↦ φ t x` solves `∂ₜ φ t x = X_{H t} (φ t x)`, where
the Hamiltonian vector field `X_{H t}` is characterised by `ω (X_{H t}, ·) = d (H t)`. -/
def IsHamiltonianFlow (ω : TwoForm I M) (H : ℝ → M → ℝ) (φ : ℝ → M → M) : Prop :=
  ContMDiff (𝓘(ℝ, ℝ).prod I) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (uncurry H) ∧ φ 0 = id ∧
    ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : M), ∃ v : TangentSpace I (φ t x),
      HasMFDerivAt 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) I (fun s ↦ φ s x) t ((1 : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight v) ∧
        ∀ w : TangentSpace I (φ t x), ω (φ t x) ![v, w] = mfderiv I 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (H t) (φ t x) w

blocks.code:
def IsHamiltonianDiffeomorph (ω : TwoForm I M) (φ : M → M) : Prop :=
  ∃ (H : ℝ → M → ℝ) (ψ : ℝ → M → M), IsHamiltonianFlow ω H ψ ∧ ψ 1 = φ
blocks.docstring:
A map `φ : M → M` is a **Hamiltonian diffeomorphism** of `(M, ω)` if it is the time-one map
of the Hamiltonian flow of some (time-dependent) Hamiltonian `H : ℝ → M → ℝ`.
blocks.name: IsHamiltonianDiffeomorph
blocks.text:
/-- A map `φ : M → M` is a **Hamiltonian diffeomorphism** of `(M, ω)` if it is the time-one map
of the Hamiltonian flow of some (time-dependent) Hamiltonian `H : ℝ → M → ℝ`. -/
def IsHamiltonianDiffeomorph (ω : TwoForm I M) (φ : M → M) : Prop :=
  ∃ (H : ℝ → M → ℝ) (ψ : ℝ → M → M), IsHamiltonianFlow ω H ψ ∧ ψ 1 = φ
variable (I)

blocks.docstring:
A map `φ : M → M` is **nondegenerate** if its graph intersects the diagonal of `M × M`
transversely, i.e. `1` is not an eigenvalue of `dφ_x` at any fixed point `x` of `φ`.

justification.closest_existing_considered: `Module.End.HasEigenvalue` (would require packaging mfderiv as an endomorphism of one tangent space; the direct formulation is simpler and equivalent).
justification.name: ArnoldGiventalConjecture.IsNondegenerate
justification.why_needed: Nondegeneracy of a diffeomorphism (1 not an eigenvalue of dφ at fixed points / graph transverse to the diagonal) is not in Mathlib.

blocks.name: IsNondegenerate
blocks.text:
/-- A map `φ : M → M` is **nondegenerate** if its graph intersects the diagonal of `M × M`
transversely, i.e. `1` is not an eigenvalue of `dφ_x` at any fixed point `x` of `φ`. -/
def IsNondegenerate (φ : M → M) : Prop :=
  ∀ x ∈ fixedPoints φ, ∀ v : TangentSpace I x,
    (mfderiv I I φ x v : TangentSpace I x) = v → v = 0

blocks.code: def critPts (f : M → ℝ) : Set M := {x | mfderiv I 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x = 0}
blocks.docstring:
The set of critical points of `f : M → ℝ`: the points where the differential of `f`
vanishes.

justification.closest_existing_considered: `IsLocalExtr`/`IsLocalMin` (not the same notion); no critical-point definition for manifolds.
justification.name: ArnoldGiventalConjecture.critPts
justification.why_needed: Critical points of a smooth function on a manifold.

blocks.name: critPts

blocks.code:
def IsMorseFunction (f : M → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ContMDiff I 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f ∧ ∀ x ∈ critPts I f, ∀ v : E,
    fderivWithin ℝ (fderivWithin ℝ (f ∘ (extChartAt I x).symm) (Set.range I)) (Set.range I)
      (extChartAt I x x) v = 0 → v = 0
blocks.docstring:
A smooth function `f : M → ℝ` is a **Morse function** if all its critical points are
nondegenerate, i.e. at every critical point `x` the Hessian of `f` (computed in the extended chart
at `x`, which is legitimate since `x` is a critical point) is a nondegenerate bilinear form.

justification.closest_existing_considered: `iteratedFDeriv`, `fderivWithin` (used as ingredients); no manifold Hessian exists.
justification.name: ArnoldGiventalConjecture.IsMorseFunction
justification.why_needed: Morse functions (nondegenerate Hessian at critical points) are absent from Mathlib; Hessian computed in the extended chart at the critical point.

blocks.name: IsMorseFunction
blocks.text:
/-- A smooth function `f : M → ℝ` is a **Morse function** if all its critical points are
nondegenerate, i.e. at every critical point `x` the Hessian of `f` (computed in the extended chart
at `x`, which is legitimate since `x` is a critical point) is a nondegenerate bilinear form. -/
def IsMorseFunction (f : M → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ContMDiff I 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f ∧ ∀ x ∈ critPts I f, ∀ v : E,
    fderivWithin ℝ (fderivWithin ℝ (f ∘ (extChartAt I x).symm) (Set.range I)) (Set.range I)
      (extChartAt I x x) v = 0 → v = 0
variable (M)

blocks.code:
noncomputable def critNumber : ℕ∞ :=
  ⨅ f : {f : M → ℝ // ContMDiff I 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f}, (critPts I f.1).encard
blocks.docstring: The minimal number of critical points of a smooth function `M → ℝ`.

justification.name: ArnoldGiventalConjecture.critNumber
justification.why_needed: Minimal number of critical points of a smooth function, the invariant in the strong Arnold conjecture.

blocks.name: critNumber
blocks.text:
/-- The minimal number of critical points of a smooth function `M → ℝ`. -/
noncomputable def critNumber : ℕ∞ :=
  ⨅ f : {f : M → ℝ // ContMDiff I 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f}, (critPts I f.1).encard

blocks.code:
noncomputable def morseNumber : ℕ∞ :=
  ⨅ f : {f : M → ℝ // IsMorseFunction I f}, (critPts I f.1).encard
blocks.docstring:
The **Morse number** of `M`: the minimal number of critical points of a Morse function on
`M`.

justification.name: ArnoldGiventalConjecture.morseNumber
justification.why_needed: Morse number of a manifold (minimal number of critical points of a Morse function).

blocks.name: morseNumber
blocks.text:
/-- The **Morse number** of `M`: the minimal number of critical points of a Morse function on
`M`. -/
noncomputable def morseNumber : ℕ∞ :=
  ⨅ f : {f : M → ℝ // IsMorseFunction I f}, (critPts I f.1).encard
end Definitions

blocks.code:
noncomputable def bettiNumber (F : Type) [Field F] (i : ℕ) (X : Type) [TopologicalSpace X] :
    ℕ :=
  Module.finrank F
    (((AlgebraicTopology.singularHomologyFunctor (ModuleCat F) i).obj (ModuleCat.of F F)).obj
      (TopCat.of X))
blocks.docstring:
The `i`-th Betti number of a topological space `X` with coefficients in a field `F`: the
dimension of the `i`-th singular homology of `X` with coefficients in `F`.

justification.name: ArnoldGiventalConjecture.bettiNumber
justification.why_needed: Betti numbers with field coefficients; Mathlib has the singular homology functor but no Betti-number definition.

blocks.name: bettiNumber
blocks.text:
/-- The `i`-th Betti number of a topological space `X` with coefficients in a field `F`: the
dimension of the `i`-th singular homology of `X` with coefficients in `F`. -/
noncomputable def bettiNumber (F : Type) [Field F] (i : ℕ) (X : Type) [TopologicalSpace X] :
    ℕ :=
  Module.finrank F
    (((AlgebraicTopology.singularHomologyFunctor (ModuleCat F) i).obj (ModuleCat.of F F)).obj
      (TopCat.of X))
section API

blocks.code:
@[category API, AMS 53 58]
theorem critPts_const (c : ℝ) : critPts I (fun _ : M ↦ c) = Set.univ := by
  ext x
  simp [critPts, mfderiv_const]
blocks.docstring: Every point is a critical point of a constant function.
blocks.name: critPts_const
blocks.text:
/-- Every point is a critical point of a constant function. -/
@[category API, AMS 53 58]
theorem critPts_const (c : ℝ) : critPts I (fun _ : M ↦ c) = Set.univ := by
  ext x
  simp [critPts, mfderiv_const]

blocks.code:
@[category API, AMS 37 53]
theorem isHamiltonianFlow_zero (ω : TwoForm I M) :
    IsHamiltonianFlow ω (fun _ _ ↦ 0) (fun _ ↦ id) := by
  refine ⟨contMDiff_const, rfl, fun t x ↦ ⟨0, ?_, fun w ↦ ?_⟩⟩
  · convert hasMFDerivAt_const (I := 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ)) (I' := I) x t using 1
    ext
    simp
  · rw [mfderiv_const, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply]
    exact (ω x).map_coord_zero 0 rfl
blocks.docstring: The constant flow `φ t = id` is the Hamiltonian flow of the zero Hamiltonian.
blocks.name: isHamiltonianFlow_zero
blocks.text:
/-- The constant flow `φ t = id` is the Hamiltonian flow of the zero Hamiltonian. -/
@[category API, AMS 37 53]
theorem isHamiltonianFlow_zero (ω : TwoForm I M) :
    IsHamiltonianFlow ω (fun _ _ ↦ 0) (fun _ ↦ id) := by
  refine ⟨contMDiff_const, rfl, fun t x ↦ ⟨0, ?_, fun w ↦ ?_⟩⟩
  · convert hasMFDerivAt_const (I := 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ)) (I' := I) x t using 1
    ext
    simp
  · rw [mfderiv_const, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply]
    exact (ω x).map_coord_zero 0 rfl
end API
section Conjectures

variable {n : ℕ} {M : Type} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace (ℝ^(2 * n)) M]
  [IsManifold (𝓡 (2 * n)) ∞ M] [T2Space M] [CompactSpace M]

blocks.code:
@[category research open, AMS 37 53]
theorem arnold_givental_conjecture.parts.i
    (ω : TwoForm (𝓡 (2 * n)) M) (hω : IsSymplecticForm ω)
    (L : Type) [TopologicalSpace L] [ChartedSpace (ℝ^n) L] [IsManifold (𝓡 n) ∞ L]
    [CompactSpace L] (ι : L → M) (hι : IsSmoothEmbedding (𝓡 n) (𝓡 (2 * n)) ∞ ι)
    (hL : ∀ (p : L) (v w : TangentSpace (𝓡 n) p),
      ω (ι p) ![mfderiv (𝓡 n) (𝓡 (2 * n)) ι p v, mfderiv (𝓡 n) (𝓡 (2 * n)) ι p w] = 0)
    (τ : M → M) (hτ : ContMDiff (𝓡 (2 * n)) (𝓡 (2 * n)) ∞ τ) (hττ : τ ∘ τ = id)
    (hτω : ∀ (x : M) (v w : TangentSpace (𝓡 (2 * n)) x),
      ω (τ x) ![mfderiv (𝓡 (2 * n)) (𝓡 (2 * n)) τ x v,
        mfderiv (𝓡 (2 * n)) (𝓡 (2 * n)) τ x w] = - ω x ![v, w])
    (hfix : fixedPoints τ = Set.range ι)
    (H : ℝ → M → ℝ) (φ : ℝ → M → M) (hφ : IsHamiltonianFlow ω H φ)
    (htrans : ∀ p q : L, φ 1 (ι p) = ι q →
      LinearMap.range ((mfderiv (𝓡 (2 * n)) (𝓡 (2 * n)) (φ 1) (ι p)).comp
          (mfderiv (𝓡 n) (𝓡 (2 * n)) ι p)).toLinearMap ⊔
        LinearMap.range (mfderiv (𝓡 n) (𝓡 (2 * n)) ι q).toLinearMap = ⊤) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (bettiNumber (ZMod 2) i L : ℕ∞) ≤
      (φ 1 '' Set.range ι ∩ Set.range ι).encard := by
  sorry
blocks.docstring:
**Arnold–Givental conjecture.** Let $(M, ω)$ be a compact $2n$-dimensional symplectic
manifold, let $L ⊂ M$ be a compact Lagrangian submanifold, and let $τ : M → M$ be an
anti-symplectic involution ($τ^*ω = -ω$, $τ^2 = \mathrm{id}_M$) whose fixed point set is $L$.
Let $H_t$ be a smooth family of Hamiltonian functions on $M$, generating the Hamiltonian flow
$φ_t$. If $φ_1(L)$ intersects $L$ transversely, then
$$\#(φ_1(L) ∩ L) ≥ \sum_{i=0}^{n} \dim H_i(L; ℤ/2ℤ).$$

Here `L` is given as an abstract compact `n`-manifold with a smooth embedding `ι : L → M` whose
image is Lagrangian (`ω` vanishes on `dι (T_p L)`), and transversality at an intersection point
`φ 1 (ι p) = ι q` means `dφ₁ (dι (T_p L)) + dι (T_q L) = T_{ι q} M`.
blocks.name: arnold_givental_conjecture.parts.i
blocks.text:
/-- **Arnold–Givental conjecture.** Let $(M, ω)$ be a compact $2n$-dimensional symplectic
manifold, let $L ⊂ M$ be a compact Lagrangian submanifold, and let $τ : M → M$ be an
anti-symplectic involution ($τ^*ω = -ω$, $τ^2 = \mathrm{id}_M$) whose fixed point set is $L$.
Let $H_t$ be a smooth family of Hamiltonian functions on $M$, generating the Hamiltonian flow
$φ_t$. If $φ_1(L)$ intersects $L$ transversely, then
$$\#(φ_1(L) ∩ L) ≥ \sum_{i=0}^{n} \dim H_i(L; ℤ/2ℤ).$$

Here `L` is given as an abstract compact `n`-manifold with a smooth embedding `ι : L → M` whose
image is Lagrangian (`ω` vanishes on `dι (T_p L)`), and transversality at an intersection point
`φ 1 (ι p) = ι q` means `dφ₁ (dι (T_p L)) + dι (T_q L) = T_{ι q} M`. -/
@[category research open, AMS 37 53]
theorem arnold_givental_conjecture.parts.i
    (ω : TwoForm (𝓡 (2 * n)) M) (hω : IsSymplecticForm ω)
    (L : Type) [TopologicalSpace L] [ChartedSpace (ℝ^n) L] [IsManifold (𝓡 n) ∞ L]
    [CompactSpace L] (ι : L → M) (hι : IsSmoothEmbedding (𝓡 n) (𝓡 (2 * n)) ∞ ι)
    (hL : ∀ (p : L) (v w : TangentSpace (𝓡 n) p),
      ω (ι p) ![mfderiv (𝓡 n) (𝓡 (2 * n)) ι p v, mfderiv (𝓡 n) (𝓡 (2 * n)) ι p w] = 0)
    (τ : M → M) (hτ : ContMDiff (𝓡 (2 * n)) (𝓡 (2 * n)) ∞ τ) (hττ : τ ∘ τ = id)
    (hτω : ∀ (x : M) (v w : TangentSpace (𝓡 (2 * n)) x),
      ω (τ x) ![mfderiv (𝓡 (2 * n)) (𝓡 (2 * n)) τ x v,
        mfderiv (𝓡 (2 * n)) (𝓡 (2 * n)) τ x w] = - ω x ![v, w])
    (hfix : fixedPoints τ = Set.range ι)
    (H : ℝ → M → ℝ) (φ : ℝ → M → M) (hφ : IsHamiltonianFlow ω H φ)
    (htrans : ∀ p q : L, φ 1 (ι p) = ι q →
      LinearMap.range ((mfderiv (𝓡 (2 * n)) (𝓡 (2 * n)) (φ 1) (ι p)).comp
          (mfderiv (𝓡 n) (𝓡 (2 * n)) ι p)).toLinearMap ⊔
        LinearMap.range (mfderiv (𝓡 n) (𝓡 (2 * n)) ι q).toLinearMap = ⊤) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (bettiNumber (ZMod 2) i L : ℕ∞) ≤
      (φ 1 '' Set.range ι ∩ Set.range ι).encard := by
  sorry

blocks.code:
@[category research open, AMS 37 53]
theorem arnold_givental_conjecture.parts.ii
    (ω : TwoForm (𝓡 (2 * n)) M) (hω : IsSymplecticForm ω)
    (φ : M → M) (hφ : IsHamiltonianDiffeomorph ω φ) :
    critNumber (𝓡 (2 * n)) M ≤ (fixedPoints φ).encard := by
  sorry
blocks.docstring:
**Arnold conjecture** (strong form). Let $(M, ω)$ be a closed symplectic manifold. The number
of fixed points of a Hamiltonian diffeomorphism of $M$ is greater than or equal to the number of
critical points of a smooth function on $M$, i.e. to the minimal number of critical points of a
smooth function $M → ℝ$.
blocks.name: arnold_givental_conjecture.parts.ii
blocks.text:
/-- **Arnold conjecture** (strong form). Let $(M, ω)$ be a closed symplectic manifold. The number
of fixed points of a Hamiltonian diffeomorphism of $M$ is greater than or equal to the number of

import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Arnold–Givental conjecture and Arnold conjecture

The *Arnold conjecture* bounds from below the number of fixed points of a Hamiltonian
diffeomorphism of a closed symplectic manifold $(M, ω)$ by Morse-theoretic invariants of $M$:
the minimal number of critical points of a smooth function on $M$ (strong form), the minimal number
of critical points of a Morse function on $M$ (nondegenerate form), or the sum of the Betti numbers
of $M$ (weak form).

The *Arnold–Givental conjecture* bounds from below the number of transverse intersection points
of a compact Lagrangian submanifold $L$, which is the fixed point set of an anti-symplectic
involution, with its image under a Hamiltonian diffeomorphism, by the sum of the $ℤ/2$-Betti
numbers of $L$.

This file introduces the required notions on top of Mathlib's smooth manifolds: symplectic forms
(fields of continuous alternating bilinear forms on the tangent spaces which are smooth and closed
in charts, and nondegenerate), time-dependent Hamiltonian flows, Hamiltonian diffeomorphisms,
nondegenerate diffeomorphisms, critical points, Morse functions, and Betti numbers via Mathlib's
singular homology. Time-dependent Hamiltonians are taken to be smooth functions on `ℝ × M`; the
time-one maps of their flows are exactly the time-one maps of smooth families indexed by `[0, 1]`
(reparametrise the time variable).

*References:*
- [Wikipedia, Arnold–Givental conjecture](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arnold%E2%80%93Givental_conjecture)
- [Wikipedia, List of unsolved problems in mathematics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_unsolved_problems_in_mathematics)
- [Fr04] Frauenfelder, U. *The Arnold–Givental conjecture and moment Floer homology*.
  International Mathematics Research Notices (2004).
  [arXiv:math/0309373](https://arxiv.org/abs/math/0309373)
- [RG17] Dimitroglou Rizell, G. and Golovko, R. *The number of Hamiltonian fixed points on
  symplectically aspherical manifolds*. [arXiv:1609.04776](https://arxiv.org/abs/1609.04776)
-/

namespace ArnoldGiventalConjecture

open scoped Manifold EuclideanGeometry
open Manifold Function

local notation "∞" => ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞)

section Definitions

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
  {H : Type*} [TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners ℝ E H)
  (M : Type*) [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M]

/-- A (not necessarily smooth) differential `2`-form on `M`: a continuous alternating bilinear
form on each tangent space `T_x M`. -/
abbrev TwoForm := ∀ x : M, TangentSpace I x [⋀^Fin 2]→L[ℝ] ℝ

variable {I M}

/-- The local representative of a `2`-form `ω` in the extended chart at `x₀`: the pullback of
`ω` along `(extChartAt I x₀).symm`, a `2`-form on the model space `E`. -/
noncomputable def TwoForm.localRep (ω : TwoForm I M) (x₀ : M) (y : E) :
    E [⋀^Fin 2]→L[ℝ] ℝ :=
  (ω ((extChartAt I x₀).symm y)).compContinuousLinearMap
    (mfderivWithin 𝓘(ℝ, E) I (extChartAt I x₀).symm (Set.range I) y)

/-- A `2`-form `ω` on `M` is a **symplectic form** if it is smooth, closed and nondegenerate.
Smoothness and closedness (`dω = 0`) are expressed through the local representatives of `ω` in
the extended charts at each point, using Mathlib's exterior derivative `extDerivWithin` on the
model space. -/
structure IsSymplecticForm (ω : TwoForm I M) : Prop where
  contDiffWithinAt : ∀ x₀ : M,
    ContDiffWithinAt ℝ ∞ (ω.localRep x₀) (Set.range I) (extChartAt I x₀ x₀)
  closed : ∀ x₀ : M, extDerivWithin (ω.localRep x₀) (Set.range I) (extChartAt I x₀ x₀) = 0
  nondegenerate : ∀ (x : M) (v : TangentSpace I x), (∀ w, ω x ![v, w] = 0) → v = 0

/-- `φ : ℝ → M → M` is the **Hamiltonian flow** of the time-dependent Hamiltonian
`H : ℝ → M → ℝ` with respect to the `2`-form `ω`: `H` is smooth (jointly in time and space),
`φ 0 = id`, and for every `x` the curve `t ↦ φ t x` solves `∂ₜ φ t x = X_{H t} (φ t x)`, where
the Hamiltonian vector field `X_{H t}` is characterised by `ω (X_{H t}, ·) = d (H t)`. -/
def IsHamiltonianFlow (ω : TwoForm I M) (H : ℝ → M → ℝ) (φ : ℝ → M → M) : Prop :=
  ContMDiff (𝓘(ℝ, ℝ).prod I) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (uncurry H) ∧ φ 0 = id ∧
    ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : M), ∃ v : TangentSpace I (φ t x),
      HasMFDerivAt 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) I (fun s ↦ φ s x) t ((1 : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight v) ∧
        ∀ w : TangentSpace I (φ t x), ω (φ t x) ![v, w] = mfderiv I 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (H t) (φ t x) w

/-- A map `φ : M → M` is a **Hamiltonian diffeomorphism** of `(M, ω)` if it is the time-one map
of the Hamiltonian flow of some (time-dependent) Hamiltonian `H : ℝ → M → ℝ`. -/
def IsHamiltonianDiffeomorph (ω : TwoForm I M) (φ : M → M) : Prop :=
  ∃ (H : ℝ → M → ℝ) (ψ : ℝ → M → M), IsHamiltonianFlow ω H ψ ∧ ψ 1 = φ

variable (I)

/-- A map `φ : M → M` is **nondegenerate** if its graph intersects the diagonal of `M × M`
transversely, i.e. `1` is not an eigenvalue of `dφ_x` at any fixed point `x` of `φ`. -/
def IsNondegenerate (φ : M → M) : Prop :=
  ∀ x ∈ fixedPoints φ, ∀ v : TangentSpace I x,
    (mfderiv I I φ x v : TangentSpace I x) = v → v = 0

/-- The set of critical points of `f : M → ℝ`: the points where the differential of `f`
vanishes. -/
def critPts (f : M → ℝ) : Set M := {x | mfderiv I 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x = 0}

/-- A smooth function `f : M → ℝ` is a **Morse function** if all its critical points are
nondegenerate, i.e. at every critical point `x` the Hessian of `f` (computed in the extended chart
at `x`, which is legitimate since `x` is a critical point) is a nondegenerate bilinear form. -/
def IsMorseFunction (f : M → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ContMDiff I 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f ∧ ∀ x ∈ critPts I f, ∀ v : E,
    fderivWithin ℝ (fderivWithin ℝ (f ∘ (extChartAt I x).symm) (Set.range I)) (Set.range I)
      (extChartAt I x x) v = 0 → v = 0

variable (M)

/-- The minimal number of critical points of a smooth function `M → ℝ`. -/
noncomputable def critNumber : ℕ∞ :=
  ⨅ f : {f : M → ℝ // ContMDiff I 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f}, (critPts I f.1).encard

/-- The **Morse number** of `M`: the minimal number of critical points of a Morse function on
`M`. -/
noncomputable def morseNumber : ℕ∞ :=
  ⨅ f : {f : M → ℝ // IsMorseFunction I f}, (critPts I f.1).encard

end Definitions

/-- The `i`-th Betti number of a topological space `X` with coefficients in a field `F`: the
dimension of the `i`-th singular homology of `X` with coefficients in `F`. -/
noncomputable def bettiNumber (F : Type) [Field F] (i : ℕ) (X : Type) [TopologicalSpace X] :
    ℕ :=
  Module.finrank F
    (((AlgebraicTopology.singularHomologyFunctor (ModuleCat F) i).obj (ModuleCat.of F F)).obj
      (TopCat.of X))

section API

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
  {H : Type*} [TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners ℝ E H}
  {M : Type*} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M]

/-- Every point is a critical point of a constant function. -/
@[category API, AMS 53 58]
theorem critPts_const (c : ℝ) : critPts I (fun _ : M ↦ c) = Set.univ := by
  ext x
  simp [critPts, mfderiv_const]

/-- The constant flow `φ t = id` is the Hamiltonian flow of the zero Hamiltonian. -/
@[category API, AMS 37 53]
theorem isHamiltonianFlow_zero (ω : TwoForm I M) :
    IsHamiltonianFlow ω (fun _ _ ↦ 0) (fun _ ↦ id) := by
  refine ⟨contMDiff_const, rfl, fun t x ↦ ⟨0, ?_, fun w ↦ ?_⟩⟩
  · convert hasMFDerivAt_const (I := 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ)) (I' := I) x t using 1
    ext
    simp
  · rw [mfderiv_const, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply]
    exact (ω x).map_coord_zero 0 rfl

end API

section Conjectures

variable {n : ℕ} {M : Type} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace (ℝ^(2 * n)) M]
  [IsManifold (𝓡 (2 * n)) ∞ M] [T2Space M] [CompactSpace M]

/-- **Arnold–Givental conjecture.** Let $(M, ω)$ be a compact $2n$-dimensional symplectic
manifold, let $L ⊂ M$ be a compact Lagrangian submanifold, and let $τ : M → M$ be an

$$\#(φ_1(L) ∩ L) ≥ \sum_{i=0}^{n} \dim H_i(L; ℤ/2ℤ).$$

image is Lagrangian (`ω` vanishes on `dι (T_p L)`), and transversality at an intersection point

@[category research open, AMS 37 53]
theorem arnold_givental_conjecture.parts.i
    (ω : TwoForm (𝓡 (2 * n)) M) (hω : IsSymplecticForm ω)
    (L : Type) [TopologicalSpace L] [ChartedSpace (ℝ^n) L] [IsManifold (𝓡 n) ∞ L]
    [CompactSpace L] (ι : L → M) (hι : IsSmoothEmbedding (𝓡 n) (𝓡 (2 * n)) ∞ ι)
    (hL : ∀ (p : L) (v w : TangentSpace (𝓡 n) p),
      ω (ι p) ![mfderiv (𝓡 n) (𝓡 (2 * n)) ι p v, mfderiv (𝓡 n) (𝓡 (2 * n)) ι p w] = 0)
    (τ : M → M) (hτ : ContMDiff (𝓡 (2 * n)) (𝓡 (2 * n)) ∞ τ) (hττ : τ ∘ τ = id)
    (hτω : ∀ (x : M) (v w : TangentSpace (𝓡 (2 * n)) x),
      ω (τ x) ![mfderiv (𝓡 (2 * n)) (𝓡 (2 * n)) τ x v,
        mfderiv (𝓡 (2 * n)) (𝓡 (2 * n)) τ x w] = - ω x ![v, w])
    (hfix : fixedPoints τ = Set.range ι)
    (H : ℝ → M → ℝ) (φ : ℝ → M → M) (hφ : IsHamiltonianFlow ω H φ)
    (htrans : ∀ p q : L, φ 1 (ι p) = ι q →
      LinearMap.range ((mfderiv (𝓡 (2 * n)) (𝓡 (2 * n)) (φ 1) (ι p)).comp
          (mfderiv (𝓡 n) (𝓡 (2 * n)) ι p)).toLinearMap ⊔
        LinearMap.range (mfderiv (𝓡 n) (𝓡 (2 * n)) ι q).toLinearMap = ⊤) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (bettiNumber (ZMod 2) i L : ℕ∞) ≤

  sorry

/-- **Arnold conjecture** (strong form). Let $(M, ω)$ be a closed symplectic manifold. The number
of fixed points of a Hamiltonian diffeomorphism of $M$ is greater than or equal to the number of

    (ω : TwoForm (𝓡 (2 * n)) M) (hω : IsSymplecticForm ω)
    (φ : M → M) (hφ : IsHamiltonianDiffeomorph ω φ) :
    critNumber (𝓡 (2 * n)) M ≤ (fixedPoints φ).encard := by

/-- **Arnold conjecture** (nondegenerate form). Let $(M, ω)$ be a closed symplectic manifold. The
number of fixed points of a nondegenerate Hamiltonian diffeomorphism of $M$ is at least the minimal
number of critical points of a Morse function on $M$ (the Morse number of $M$). -/
@[category research open, AMS 37 53]
theorem arnold_givental_conjecture.variants.nondegenerate_morse_number
    (ω : TwoForm (𝓡 (2 * n)) M) (hω : IsSymplecticForm ω)
    (φ : M → M) (hφ : IsHamiltonianDiffeomorph ω φ)
    (hnd : IsNondegenerate (𝓡 (2 * n)) φ) :

/-- **Weak Arnold conjecture.** Let $(M, ω)$ be a closed $2n$-dimensional symplectic manifold and

items: Manifolds follow the repo convention (Millenium/Poincare.lean): `M : Type`, `ChartedSpace (ℝ^(2 * n)) M`, `IsManifold (𝓡 (2 * n)) ∞ M`, plus `[T2Space M] [CompactSpace M]`; 'closed' = compact + boundaryless model `𝓡 (2n)` (Mathlib's IsManifold does not include Hausdorff, so T2Space is added explicitly).

A 2-form is `∀ x, TangentSpace I x [⋀^Fin 2]→L[ℝ] ℝ` (continuous alternating map, so antisymmetry is built in), using Mathlib's convention that `TangentSpace I x = E` carries chart-at-x coordinates, consistent with `mfderiv` and `HasMFDerivAt`.

Smoothness and closedness of ω are defined through the local representative `TwoForm.localRep ω x₀ = ((extChartAt I x₀).symm)^* ω` (built with `compContinuousLinearMap` and `mfderivWithin … (range I)`, mirroring Mathlib's `mlieBracket` design), requiring `ContDiffWithinAt ℝ ∞ … (range I)` and `extDerivWithin … (range I) = 0` at the chart centre `extChartAt I x₀ x₀` for every x₀. Since every point is the centre of its own chart and both conditions are chart-invariant (pullback commutes with d), this is equivalent to ω being a smooth closed form; for boundaryless models the `Within (range I)` versions reduce to `ContDiffAt`/`extDeriv`.
Nondegeneracy of ω: ∀ x v, (∀ w, ω x ![v, w] = 0) → v = 0 (injectivity of v ↦ ω(v,·), equivalent to nondegeneracy in finite dimension).

Hamiltonian flow: `IsHamiltonianFlow ω H φ` requires H : ℝ → M → ℝ jointly smooth on ℝ × M (`ContMDiff (𝓘(ℝ, ℝ).prod I) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (uncurry H)`), φ 0 = id, and for all t, x the curve s ↦ φ s x has derivative v at t (`HasMFDerivAt … ((1 : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight v)`, as in Mathlib's `IsIntegralCurveAt`) with ω (φ t x) ![v, w] = d(H t) w for all w (Wikipedia's convention ω(X_H, ·) = dH). Time is ℝ rather than [0,1]: the set of time-one maps is the same (reparametrise time by a function flat at the endpoints), and Hamiltonians on ℝ × M avoid manifolds with boundary. No smoothness/bijectivity of φ_t is assumed: on a compact manifold the ODE solution is unique, so φ is forced to be the genuine flow.
Hamiltonian diffeomorphism: ∃ H ψ, IsHamiltonianFlow ω H ψ ∧ ψ 1 = φ.

Nondegenerate diffeomorphism: at each fixed point x, (mfderiv I I φ x v : TangentSpace I x) = v → v = 0, i.e. 1 is not an eigenvalue of dφ_x, which the article/notes state is equivalent to graph ⋔ diagonal (the type ascription is needed because `TangentSpace I (φ x)` and `TangentSpace I x` are only defeq).

Critical points: `critPts I f = {x | mfderiv I 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x = 0}`; the 'number of critical points of a smooth function on M' in the strong Arnold conjecture is read as the minimum over smooth functions (`critNumber I M = ⨅ f smooth, (critPts I f).encard` in ℕ∞), as the notes require. All cardinalities use `Set.encard` so that infinite fixed-point sets satisfy every lower bound (ncard would wrongly give 0).

Morse function: smooth f whose chart-Hessian `fderivWithin ℝ (fderivWithin ℝ (f ∘ (extChartAt I x).symm) (range I)) (range I) (extChartAt I x x)` is nondegenerate (v ↦ Hess v injective) at every critical point x; the Hessian at a critical point is chart-independent, so this is the standard notion. Morse number = infimum of encard of critical sets over Morse functions.

Betti numbers: `bettiNumber F i X = Module.finrank F (H_i(X; F))` with H_i from `AlgebraicTopology.singularHomologyFunctor (ModuleCat F) i` applied to `ModuleCat.of F F` and `TopCat.of X`; fields F live in `Type` (every characteristic is realised there, and the Betti sum depends only on char F). ℤ/2 coefficients are `ZMod 2`.

Arnold–Givental: L is an abstract compact manifold modelled on ℝ^n with `IsSmoothEmbedding (𝓡 n) (𝓡 (2 * n)) ∞ ι` (Mathlib has no embedded-submanifold notion), Lagrangian = dimension n (from the model) plus ω vanishing on dι(T_pL) (`hL`, redundant given τ but stated in the source); 'fixed point set is L' is `fixedPoints τ = Set.range ι`; τ is a smooth map with τ ∘ τ = id (hence a diffeomorphism) and τ*ω = -ω pointwise via mfderiv. Transversality of φ₁(L) and L is `LinearMap.range (dφ₁ ∘ dι_p).toLinearMap ⊔ LinearMap.range (dι_q).toLinearMap = ⊤` whenever φ 1 (ι p) = ι q (the `⊔` lives in `Submodule ℝ (TangentSpace _ (φ 1 (ι p)))`, defeq to the tangent space at ι q; I checked in a scratch file that this implies the elementwise 'every u is dφ₁(dι a) + dι b' statement). Intersection count is `(φ 1 '' Set.range ι ∩ Set.range ι).encard` in M.
Slot iv is tagged `research solved` (the notes say it is a theorem); slots i–iii are `research open`. AMS tags 37 (dynamical systems) and 53 (differential geometry).
The scoped `ContDiff` notation `ω` (analytic smoothness) clashes with the variable name ω, so the file defines `local notation "∞" => ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞)` instead of `open scoped ContDiff`.
Two `@[category API]` sanity checks with short proofs are included: `critPts_const` and `isHamiltonianFlow_zero` (the constant flow is the Hamiltonian flow of the zero Hamiltonian).

reviewer_notes:
Source ambiguity: the list entry is a bare title; all four slots were read through the linked Wikipedia article (cross-checked with Frauenfelder arXiv:math/0309373 for AG). The article's 'number of critical points of a smooth function' was read as the minimum over smooth functions, as the decomposition prescribes. Time-dependent Hamiltonians are indexed by ℝ rather than [0,1]; the class of time-one maps is unchanged (extend/reparametrise in time). Sign convention ω(X_H,·)=dH as in the article (irrelevant for the counts).

Candidate verdicts: c07 (chosen for all slots; compiles with only sorry warnings; verified that its local-representative construction gives the constant form for a constant form on the model space). c08, c02, c06 are essentially equivalent faithful alternatives (bilinear-form bundle + invariant dω formula, or per-atlas-chart pullbacks). c01 rejected: uses `⊤ : WithTop ℕ∞` (analytic, ω) instead of `∞` everywhere, so it states the conjectures for analytic manifolds/functions/Hamiltonians. c03 rejected: smoothness/closedness of the 'form' is imposed on `form ∘ chart.symm` without pulling back by the chart derivative (mixes chart-at-y coordinates for varying y, not chart-invariant), no T2Space, imports Mathlib directly. c04 rejected: no T2Space hypothesis (non-Hausdorff compact 'manifolds' admitted, where ODE uniqueness and the conjecture's setting fail), plus extra direct Mathlib imports. c05 bailed out claiming manifold differential forms are missing primitives; this is over-cautious — smoothness/closedness of a 2-form via correctly pulled-back chart representatives (or via smooth sections of the bilinear-form bundle plus the invariant formula) is a faithful standard encoding, as several compiling candidates show. Residual risk: the bespoke symplectic/Hamiltonian definitions are elaborate and rely on Mathlib's TangentSpace/mfderiv chart conventions; I checked these conventions but a subtle coordinate mismatch cannot be excluded with full certainty.
